# TEXTURE_COVERAGE.md -- shipped-asset audit

Resource paths the game code loads vs assets present in the jar. A **MISSING** path is one the code opens but the jar does not contain -> at runtime the loader gets a NULL image and crashes. Everything here is copied into `Content\` with its exact jar path so the loader needs no changes.

- code needs: 15   jar provides: 16   **present: 10   MISSING: 5**   (jar extras: 6)

## MISSING -- code loads these but the jar lacks them (runtime crash)

| Resource path | Loaded by |
|---|---|
| `a-b_c/d.e.txt` | Foo.java |
| `a.png` | Foo.java |
| `missing/nothing.png` | Foo.java |
| `upper/java.png` | Upper.JAVA |
| `x.jpg` | Foo.java |

## PNGs normalized to RGBA (the 360 render fix)

These were palettized/grayscale in the jar and would misrender as garbage colors if copied raw (the 360 texture loader expects 32-bit RGBA). They were decoded to RGBA8888 (honoring palette transparency) on extraction:

- `gui/items.png`
- `terrain.png`
- `misc/water.png`
- `font/default.png`
- `misc/tiny.png`
- `misc/wide.png`
- `misc/Mixed.PNG`
- `misc/spiral.png`

- `lang/de_DE.lang`
- `misc/Mixed.PNG`
- `misc/notes.txt`
- `misc/spiral.png`
- `misc/wide.png`
